title: SOMA Auth: approve LinkedIn app verification
_note: The verification link is generated per request on the app's Settings tab (Verify, then Generate URL); this one is for app 264207680 and the Minds Aligned page. A Page admin approves it while signed in as himself, not in LISA (page-acting) mode.

steps.instruction: This is the approval page for the SOMA app and the Minds Aligned page. Click Verify. If LinkedIn says you are acting as a company page, switch to yourself in the Me menu first and reload.
